title: 2  Processing Seaflow data
text:
2.2 Binning all cruises
First, we will carry out the actual binning.


Code
for(cruisename in cruises){
  cat(cruisename, "\n")

  ## Read particle-level data.
  vct_dir <- str_glue("{raw_data_dir}/{cruisename}/{cruisename}_vct_slim")
  vct_files <- list.files(vct_dir, "\\.parquet$", full.names = TRUE)

  cat("Length of cruise =", length(vct_files), "cytograms.", "\n")

  list_of_df <- lapply(1:length(vct_files), function(ifile){ read_parquet(vct_files[ifile]) })
  vct <- bind_rows(list_of_df)
  invisible(gc())
  
  ## Do the actual gridding now
  vct["fsc_small_coord"] <- as.integer(cut(vct[["fsc_small"]],
                                           grid_bins[["fsc_small"]],
                                           labels = FALSE,
                                           right = FALSE))
  vct["pe_coord"] <- as.integer(cut(vct[["pe"]],
                                    grid_bins[["pe"]],
                                    labels = FALSE,
                                    right = FALSE))
  vct["chl_small_coord"] <- as.integer(cut(vct[["chl_small"]],
                                           grid_bins[["chl_small"]],
                                           labels = FALSE,
                                           right = FALSE))

  ## Remove beads
  vct <- vct %>% filter(pop != "beads")
  
  ## Gridding the data and summing the Qcs in each 3d grid bin.
  gridded <- vct %>%
    group_by(date, across(ends_with("_coord")), pop) %>%
    summarise(Qc = sum(Qc), .groups="drop") %>%
    select(date, fsc_small_coord, chl_small_coord, pe_coord,  Qc) %>%
    arrange(date, fsc_small_coord, chl_small_coord, pe_coord)

  ## Aggregate to hourly level
  hourly_gridded <- gridded %>%
    group_by(date=floor_date(date, "1 hours"), across(ends_with("_coord"))) %>%
    summarise(Qc=sum(Qc), .groups="drop") %>%
    arrange(date, fsc_small_coord, chl_small_coord, pe_coord)
  invisible(gc())
  
  ## Each cruise's binned data is now saved to a file
  filename <- paste0(cruisename, "-gridded-before-cleaning.csv")
  dir.create(file.path(outputdir, cruisename))
  outfile <- file.path(outputdir, cruisename, filename)

  write.csv(hourly_gridded, file = outfile, row.names = FALSE) 

  cat("wrote to", outfile, fill=TRUE)
}


Let’s see, for every cruise, 1d plots for all 3 dimensions. This is before any cleaning.


Code
for(cruisename in cruises){
  ## Load data
  csv_filename <- paste0(cruisename, "-gridded-before-cleaning.csv")
  datlist <- csv_to_datlist(outputdir = file.path(outputdir, cruisename),
                            csv_filename = csv_filename)
  ylist <- datlist$ylist
  biomass_list <- datlist$biomass_list
  dates <- datlist$datetimes
  rm(datlist)
  gc()

  ## Make a 1d plot over time for each response dimension.
  plotlist <- lapply(1:3, function(idim){
    datobj_1d <- flowmix::collapse_3d_to_1d(ylist = ylist, countslist = biomass_list, idim = idim)
    
    flowtrend::plot_1d(ylist = datobj_1d$ylist,
                       countslist = datobj_1d$countslist,  bin = TRUE,
                       x = dates) +
      scale_fill_gradientn(colours = c("white", "black", "yellow", "red")) +
      ggtitle(cruisename) +
      ylab(c("fsc (forward scatter)", "chl", "pe")[idim])
  })

  one_d_plot <- cowplot::plot_grid(plotlist = plotlist, ncol = 1)

  # Save to Dropbox for portability
  ggsave(
    file.path(outputdir, cruisename, paste0(cruisename, "-gridded-before-cleaning.png")), 
    one_d_plot, 
    width = 16, 
    height = 12, 
    units = "in", 
    create.dir = TRUE
  ) %>% suppressMessages()

  # Also save to local figures folder so the Bookdown can be created
  ggsave(
    file.path("figures", cruisename, paste0(cruisename, "-gridded-before-cleaning.png")), 
    one_d_plot, 
    width = 16, 
    height = 12, 
    units = "in", 
    create.dir = TRUE
  ) %>% suppressMessages()
}

title: 2  Processing Seaflow data
text:
2.3 Data cleaning notes
Next, we will clean/process the binned data.
Here are some points that came up while cleaning data.

The binning was done using 80 bins in FSC dimension, and 40 bins in other dimensions. However, FSC in a given cruise usually occupies only 40-ish bins.
Most cruises have upper CHL censoring.
G5 (TN412_130) PE values all fall in the bottom bin. Although at first glance these may look like censored points, they aren’t! We don’t and shouldn’t remove these! (They are more like truncated points.)
G1 might a level jump in Prochlorococcus levels in the middle of the cruise. This is apparent from 1d plots and the series of 3d bin plots.

      ), 
      face = "bold", 
      size = 10
    )
  )

ggsave(filename = rm_filename, plot = removed_cytogram_plot, width = 8, height = 15) %>% 
  suppressMessages()

raw_data_dir <- "~/Dropbox/data/ocean/raw-seaflow/particle-data-2026-09-22"

for(cruisename in cruisenames_other){
  ## Read particle-level data.
  vct_dir <- str_glue("{raw_data_dir}/{cruisename}/{cruisename}_vct_slim")
  vct_files <- list.files(vct_dir, "\\.parquet$", full.names = TRUE)
  list_of_df = lapply(1:length(vct_files), function(ifile){ read_parquet(vct_files[ifile]) })
  vct <- bind_rows(list_of_df)
  invisible(gc())
  
  ## Do the actual gridding now
  vct["fsc_small_coord"] <- as.integer(cut(vct[["fsc_small"]],
                                           grid_bins[["fsc_small"]],
                                           labels = FALSE,
                                           right = FALSE))
  vct["pe_coord"] <- as.integer(cut(vct[["pe"]],
                                    grid_bins[["pe"]],
                                    labels = FALSE,
                                    right = FALSE))
  vct["chl_small_coord"] <- as.integer(cut(vct[["chl_small"]],
                                           grid_bins[["chl_small"]],
                                           labels = FALSE,
                                           right = FALSE))

  ## Remove beads
  vct = vct %>% filter(pop != "beads")
  
  ## Gridding the data and summing the Qcs in each 3d grid bin.
  gridded <- vct %>%
    group_by(date, across(ends_with("_coord")), pop) %>%
    summarise(Qc = sum(Qc), .groups="drop") %>%
    select(date, fsc_small_coord, chl_small_coord, pe_coord,  Qc) %>%
    arrange(date, fsc_small_coord, chl_small_coord, pe_coord)

  ## Aggregate to hourly level
  hourly_gridded <- gridded %>%
    group_by(date=floor_date(date, "1 hours"), across(ends_with("_coord"))) %>%
    summarise(Qc=sum(Qc), .groups="drop") %>%
    arrange(date, fsc_small_coord, chl_small_coord, pe_coord)
  invisible(gc())
  
  ## Each cruise's binned data is now saved to a file
  filename = paste0(cruisename, "-gridded-before-cleaning.csv")
  outfile = file.path(outputdir, cruisename, filename)
  write.csv(hourly_gridded, file = outfile, row.names = FALSE)
  cat("wrote to", outfile, fill=TRUE)
}

invisible(gc())

2.5 Processing the remaining cruises
The remaining cruises will be processed more automatically, and with simpler rules.

This is the main cleaning we’ll do authomatically – every top and bottom bin in every dimension will be set aside and called censored data (biomass).
Thompson_3 data looks pretty weird. Many cytograms to remove.
Next up: many of the cruises have a few cytograms that are weird (and don’t look like a typical cytogram) and should be removed.



Code
for(cruisename in cruisenames_other){

  ## Print the markdown header for the tab
  cat_tab(cruisename)

  ## Load binned data
  csv_filename = paste0(cruisename, "-gridded-before-cleaning.csv")
  datlist <- csv_to_datlist(outputdir = file.path(outputdir, cruisename),
                            csv_filename = csv_filename)
  ylist <- datlist$ylist; biomass_list <- datlist$biomass_list; dates <- datlist$datetimes

  slack_top_fsc = ifelse(cruisename == "Thompson_3", 1, 0)
  normalize_by_total_biomass = TRUE

  ######################################
  ## Process top and bottom edges     ##
  ######################################
  gg_init = my_marginal_plotter(ylist, biomass_list, dates)
  
  res1 = my_edge_bin_remove(ylist = ylist, biomass_list = biomass_list, dimname = "chl_small", min_or_max = "max")
  g1 = my_marginal_plotter(res1$ylist, res1$biomass_list, dates, normalize_by_total_biomass)

  res2 = my_edge_bin_remove(res1, dimname = "chl_small", min_or_max = "min")
  g2 = my_marginal_plotter(res2$ylist, res2$biomass_list, dates, normalize_by_total_biomass)

  res3 = my_edge_bin_remove(res2, dimname = "fsc_small", min_or_max = "max", slack = slack_top_fsc)
  g3 = my_marginal_plotter(res3$ylist, res3$biomass_list, dates, normalize_by_total_biomass)

  res4 = my_edge_bin_remove(res3, dimname = "fsc_small", min_or_max = "min")
  g4 = my_marginal_plotter(res4$ylist, res4$biomass_list, dates, normalize_by_total_biomass)

  res5 = my_edge_bin_remove(res4, dimname = "pe", min_or_max = "max")
  g5 = my_marginal_plotter(res5$ylist, res5$biomass_list, dates, normalize_by_total_biomass)

  res6 = my_edge_bin_remove(res5, dimname = "pe", min_or_max = "min")
  g6 = my_marginal_plotter(res6$ylist, res6$biomass_list, dates, normalize_by_total_biomass)

  ## Save and print unified plot  
  combined_plot <- plot_grid(
    plotlist = list(
      gg_init %>% add_title("Initial", .99),
      g1 %>% add_title("After CHL top removal", .99),
      g2 %>% add_title("After CHL bottom removal", .99),
      g3 %>% add_title("After FSC top removal", .99),
      g4 %>% add_title("After FSC bottom removal", .99),
      g5 %>% add_title("After PE top removal", .99),
      g6 %>% add_title("After PE bottom removal", .99)
    ),
    ncol = 1
  )

  combined_plot_filename <- file.path(outputdir, cruisename, paste0(cruisename, "-censor-removal.png"))

  ggsave(
    combined_plot_filename, 
    combined_plot, 
    width = 10, 
    height = 70, 
    limitsize = FALSE
  ) %>% 
    suppressMessages()
  
  ggsave(
    ile.path("figures", cruisename, paste0(cruisename, "-censor-removal.png")), 
    combined_plot, 
    width = 10, 
    height = 70, 
    limitsize = FALSE
  ) %>% 
    suppressMessages()
    
  ###########################################################
  ## Save Gridded Data (Regular & Censored)               ###
  ###########################################################
  df_reconstructed <- recombine_to_csv(res6$ylist, res6$biomass_list, dates)
  save_reconstructed_csv(df_reconstructed, cruisename, outputdir, "-gridded-after-cleaning.csv")

  df_censored <- recombine_censored_data(
      all_ylists = list(res1$ylist_cens, res2$ylist_cens, res3$ylist_cens, 
                        res4$ylist_cens, res5$ylist_cens, res6$ylist_cens),
      all_biomass_lists = list(res1$biomass_list_cens, res2$biomass_list_cens, res3$biomass_list_cens,
                               res4$biomass_list_cens, res5$biomass_list_cens, res6$biomass_list_cens),
      dates = dates
  )
  save_reconstructed_csv(df_censored, cruisename, outputdir, "-gridded-after-cleaning-censored.csv")

  ## Memory Cleanup
  rm(datlist, ylist, biomass_list, dates,
     res1, res2, res3, res4, res5, res6,
     g1, g2, g3, g4, g5, g6, gg_init, 
     df_reconstructed, df_censored)
  
  invisible(gc())
}
